verdict.rationale: The open DOR pages point to a published list of B&O tax rates by classification and a sales/use tax rate lookup, so statutory rate amounts are self-served rather than routed through a contact form. The business license application mentions a required payment but no fee amount appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: published business license application and endorsement fee amounts, the actual fee/rate figures quoted in evidence, and corroboration that amounts are complete and current.
